description.value: Neptune Wonton Noodle is a Chinese noodle restaurant operated by the Neptune Group, situated inside the McArthurGlen Designer Outlet adjacent to Vancouver International Airport. It is one of two Neptune Wonton Noodle outlets in Richmond, part of a multi-brand restaurant group that has operated in Greater Vancouver since 1997. The outlet shares the mall footprint with sibling brand Ryuu Japanese Kitchen.
